structured_output.what_is_happening: TOE ROGAN (TOE) is a Meteora virtual-curve token, already migrated to a PumpSwap pool, that is 13 minutes old at about $108k market cap. It gained about 124% in its first hour on $435k of volume. It is one of at least 10 "TOE ROGAN" clones launched within roughly 30 minutes, apparently set off by a Joe Rogan X post. Two older clones are bigger right now: 6ZHF has $828k hourly volume at $126k market cap, and F3C2 has $535k at $125k. This contract's own website link points to F3C2.

narrative.description: A "Toe Rogan" pun meme, apparently tied to a specific joeroganhq X post. A burst of same-name launches points to a live but short-lived trigger event.
narrative.why_spreading: Launch snipers and bots hit every ticker that matches a celebrity post. Retail attention is split across many clones with no clear main contract.

token_connection.why_this_token: The name and ticker match the meme, and this contract has high volume and many unique buyers. But it was created about 10 minutes after the first clones, and its own website links to another contract (F3C2), which marks it as a copy.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 6ZHF (created earlier, higher volume and market cap), F3C2 (earlier, the contract linked from this token's own website), plus about 8 other TOE ROGAN clones, several already at zero liquidity, and an older TOEROGAN token.

authenticity.evidence: Buying is broad: 1,287 unique buyers against 121 sellers, and 2.4k buys against 1.3k sells in the first hour. No paid boosts. However, GMGN tags 75 bundler wallets, the creator has already closed out, and the project links were copied from a different contract.
authenticity.uncertainty: I can't see the X post or whether any community has picked this contract. The buyer breadth may be bots rotating across all the clones.

structural_risks: RugCheck says 99.99% of the LP is unlocked, but GMGN reports an LP burn ratio of 1.0, and the two conflict
One unlabeled holder owns 80% of supply, possibly the Meteora curve or pool vault, but not confirmed
GMGN tags 75 bundler wallets, and the creator has already exited
Liquidity is only about $30k in a pool about 13 minutes old
Attention is split across 10+ same-name clones
